programme.title: Pandemónio
programme.desc: Quando um vírus letal, capaz de tornar as pessoas extremamente violentas e selvagens, se alastra num edifício de escritórios, o advogado Derek Cho e uma cliente insatisfeita terão de unir esforços para lutar pela sobrevivência.

programme.title: Sin City: Mulher Fatal
programme.desc: Alguns dos cidadãos mais duros e resistentes da brutal metrópole que é Sin City cruzam-se com alguns dos seus habitantes mais sanguinários, em histórias de vingança e redenção.

programme.title: Estado De Guerra
programme.desc: Durante a Guerra do Iraque, um novo sargento assume o comando de uma equipa altamente treinada em desmantelamento de bombas. No meio de conflitos violentos, com a cidade a explodir num absoluto caos, ele vai revelar a sua verdadeira personalidade e mudará para sempre aqueles homens.

programme.title: Altamira
programme.desc: Em 1879, Marcelino, que vive na comunidade espanhola de Cantábria, descobre uma caverna com pinturas rupestres do Paleolítico Superior, mas vai ter de provar que elas são verídicas quando a Igreja Católica o quer desacreditar por perceber que elas ameaçam aquilo que é descrito na Bíblia.

programme.title: Intriga Internacional
programme.desc: Roger O. Thornhill é um executivo publicitário que é confundido com um agente federal por um grupo de espiões. O equívoco dá lugar a uma série de mal-entendidos, incluindo a acusação de homicídio, tentativas de rapto e perseguições, quer por parte dos espiões, quer por parte do governo.

programme.title: Antes Do Adeus
programme.desc: Nick e Brooke são dois estranhos retidos em Manhattan durante a noite, que vão gradualmente tornar-se confidentes um do outro. À medida que as horas passam, o inesperado acontece e eles acabam por ser forçados a confrontar os seus medos e assumir o controlo das suas vidas.

programme.title: Match Point
programme.desc: Chris Wilton é um instrutor de ténis que ascende na sociedade londrina graças a um casamento oportunista, mas tudo é colocado em risco quando inicia um romance com a namorada americana do cunhado, o que o levará a tomar medidas extremas com consequências terríveis.

programme.title: Palpitações
programme.desc: No momento em que Val e Earl decidem deixar Perfection, no Nevada, descobrem que a cidade está infestada de gigantescas criaturas devoradoras de homens que vivem debaixo da superfície. Agora, eles vão ter de se defender dos monstros que estão a matar os humanos um a um.

programme.title: Missão Inesperada
programme.desc: Jim Hanson, um ex-atirador de elite do exército, vive junto à isolada fronteira entre os EUA e o México e torna-se inesperadamente o protetor de um menino mexicano, quando um perigoso cartel de droga mata a mãe do rapaz e os começa a perseguir de forma implacável.

programme.title: Covil De Ladrões
programme.desc: A unidade de elite de combate ao crime de Los Angeles, que nem sempre joga pelas regras, entra em confronto com o gangue de assalto a bancos mais bem sucedido da cidade. Quando os fora-da-lei decidem assaltar a Reserva Federal, qual dos dois se revelará o mais implacável?

programme.title: Os Empatas
programme.desc: Quando três pais ficam a saber que as suas filhas fizeram um pacto entre si para perderem a virgindade no baile de finalistas, eles iniciam uma missão secreta para boicotarem os seus planos.

programme.title: Regresso ao Futuro
programme.desc: Marty McFly, um típico jovem americano dos anos 80, aciona acidentalmente uma máquina do tempo construída num DeLorean pelo excêntrico cientista Doc Brown e regressa ao ano de 1955, onde conhece a sua futura mãe, que se apaixona por ele colocando assim em risco a sua própria existência.

programme.title: Emboscada
programme.desc: Durante a guerra do Vietname, um grupo de comandos de elite americanos, liderados pelo Capitão Drummond, são encarregues de recolher informação altamente confidencial numa missão arriscada que poderá mudar por completo o rumo do conflito.

programme.title: Jiu Jitsu
programme.desc: De seis em seis anos, uma antiga ordem de mestres de Jiu Jitsu une forças para enfrentar e derrotar perigosos invasores alienígenas. Mas quando o derradeiro lutador da Terra é derrotado pelo líder dos invasores, o futuro do planeta e da humanidade fica em jogo...

programme.title: Há Alguma Coisa No Celeiro
programme.desc: Uma família americana realiza o sonho de regressar às suas raízes depois de herdar uma cabana remota nas montanhas da Noruega. Só que há uma enorme surpresa à espera deles…

programme.title: T.I.M. - O Protótipo
programme.desc: Abi é uma engenheira que assume um alto cargo numa companhia de robótica e se muda para uma casa de campo onde terá de lidar com o protótipo de um robô humanoide dotado de inteligência artificial, que lhe serve de criado mas que ficará cada vez mais obcecado por ela.

programme.title: A Noite Interminável
programme.desc: Esta noite é como todas as outras para Mady, estudante de dia e serralheiro de noite. Mas Claire, a jovem enigmática que ele ajuda naquela noite, não é quem ela diz ser. Mady tem apenas uma noite para provar a sua inocência numa cidade belga em turbulência com a população em protesto.

programme.title: Vicky Cristina Barcelona
programme.desc: Vicky e Cristina são duas amigas americanas a passar as férias de Verão em Barcelona, que se apaixonam pelo mesmo homem, o pintor Juan Antonio. Como se a situação já não fosse complicada, reentra em cena a ex-mulher dele, com quem ele sempre teve uma relação tempestuosa.

programme.title: Uma Aventura Nos Mares - A 1ª Viagem De Circum-Navegação
programme.desc: A história da primeira viagem de volta ao mundo, que arrancou em 1519 e se iniciou sob o comando do português Fernão de Magalhães, numa crónica dos navegadores que se colocaram ao leme da História e mudaram o rumo da Humanidade.

programme.title: O Melhor Homem
programme.desc: Um grupo de mercenários toma o controlo do hotel de um resort remoto durante um casamento e cabe ao padrinho, ao noivo e ao seu melhor amigo bêbado tentarem deter os terroristas e salvar os reféns.

programme.title: Está Tudo Louco!
programme.desc: Um magnata jogador decide criar um novo veículo para apostas a dinheiro: uma corrida de mais de 900 quilómetros, de um casino de Las Vegas até uma estação de comboio no Novo México, onde se encontra um saco com dois milhões de dólares, que ficará para quem lá chegar primeiro.

programme.title: Os Empatas
programme.desc: Quando três pais ficam a saber que as suas filhas fizeram um pacto entre si para perderem a virgindade no baile de finalistas, eles iniciam uma missão secreta para boicotarem os seus planos.

programme.title: Regresso ao Futuro
programme.desc: Marty McFly, um típico jovem americano dos anos 80, aciona acidentalmente uma máquina do tempo construída num DeLorean pelo excêntrico cientista Doc Brown e regressa ao ano de 1955, onde conhece a sua futura mãe, que se apaixona por ele colocando assim em risco a sua própria existência.

programme.title: Hércules - A Lenda Começa
programme.desc: Em 1200 a.C, na Grécia Antiga, o príncipe Hércules desconhece que é filho de Zeus e só deseja o amor da Princesa de Creta, prometida em casamento ao seu irmão. Agora, ele vai ter de fazer uma escolha: fugir com o seu verdadeiro amor ou cumprir o seu destino e tornar-se o grande herói do seu tempo.

programme.title: Gone - 12 Horas Para Viver
programme.desc: Jill Parrish está convencida que Molly, a sua irmã desaparecida, foi sequestrada pelo mesmo assassino em série de quem escapou no ano anterior. Mas será que Jill se encontra psicologicamente perturbada ou é a única que conhece a verdade, conseguindo encontrar Molly antes que seja tarde demais?

programme.title: Capturado
programme.desc: Quando o filho de um antigo agente das forças especiais é raptado, a única forma dele o recuperar com vida é eliminar três perigosos sindicatos do crime cheios de criminosos altamente treinados.

programme.title: Duchess Implacável
programme.desc: Scarlett Monaghan, mais conhecida como Duchess, entra no submundo do contrabando de diamantes, torna-se a líder implacável de um grupo de crime organizado e vai fazer tudo para vingar a morte do homem que amou.

programme.title: First Kill Caça Ao Homem
programme.desc: Will Beeman é um bem sucedido profissional de Wall Street cujo filho é raptado. Para resgatar o rapaz, ele terá ajudar o raptor a recuperar a chave que dá acesso ao dinheiro roubado num banco, sempre perseguido pelo chefe da polícia Marvin Howell.

programme.title: Justiça Traída
programme.desc: Um escritor de romances rico e famoso é baleado mortalmente e o assassino suicida-se em seguida. O jornalista David Leader vai investigar o sucedido e depara-se com uma história que envolve uma família rica, uma relação incestuosa e muitas perguntas sem resposta.

programme.title: Bizet - Carmen
programme.desc: The wild and breathtaking scenery of Austria's Roman Quarry of St. Margarethen provides an ideal and unique backdrop for this live and colourful open-air performance of Georges Bizet's opera Carmen (1875). With over 400 participants, this opulent staging of Bizet's famous opera - one of the most popular works in the genre's history - proves a feast for all the senses. Austria's Opera Festival St.

programme.title: Europakonzert 1996: Saint Petersburg
programme.desc: The beautiful Mariinsky Theatre in St. Petersburg formed the background for the 1996 edition of the annual Europakonzert of the Berliner Philharmoniker. In honour of the Russian hosts, the concert opened with highlights from Prokofiev's 'Romeo and Juliet', followed by the Cavatina from Rachmaninoff's opera 'Aleko'.

programme.title: Discovering Masterpieces – Symphonie Fantastique
programme.desc: Watch the series ‘Discovering Masterpieces’, your audio-visual concert guide to the great masterpieces of classical music. The series brings you 20 half-hour documentaries on 20 classical masterpieces: acclaimed experts, famous soloists and outstanding conductors take you on a journey back to the time and place of composition. In today’s documentary, Hector Berlioz’ ‘Symphonie Fantastique’.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances perform Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. Beethoven composed Symphony No.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Semi-finals: Schubert, Ullmann a. o.
programme.desc: Soprano Ana Carolina Coutinho (Brazil, 1993) and pianist Megumi Kuroda (Japan, 1989) perform Franz Schubert’s Die Blumensprache, D. 519; ‘Sonnenuntergang’ from Viktor Ullmann’s Drei Hölderlin-Lieder; ‘Verschwiegene Liebe’ from Hugo Wolf’s Eichendorff-Lieder; ‘Il vole’ and ‘Fleurs’ from Francis Poulenc’s Fiançailles pour rire, FP 101; ‘Wasserrose’ from Richard Strauss’s Mädchenblumen, Op.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Lucerne Festival 2004 - Pollini plays Beethoven
programme.desc: Maurizio Pollini and the Lucerne Festival play under the baton of maestro Claudio Abbado. At the yearly Lucerne Festival in Switzerland they perform the beautiful Piano Concerto No 4 by Ludwig van Beethoven. This Piano Concerto was composed between 1805 and 1806 and Beethoven himself played the solo when the concerto premiered in December 1808.

programme.title: Stravinsky: Firebird Suite No. 2
programme.desc: Iván Fischer conducts the Budapest Festival Orchestra in a concert recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary in 2015. The concert opens with Sergei Prokofiev's Overture on Hebrew Themes, Op. 34. After this, Thomas Zehetmair stars as solo violinist in Prokofiev Violin Concerto No. 2, Op. 63. The second part of the concert is features music by Igor Stravinsky.

programme.title: First Snow
programme.desc: One of the first Christmas carols ever written is Perotin the Great’s Salvatoris Hodie. This brilliant 12th century composition, one of the first works ever written for four voices, opens First Snow: the atmospheric Christmas concert by the Brussels Philharmonic.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Semi-finals: Debussy, Schubert a. o.
programme.desc: Mezzo-soprano Ekaterina Chayka-Rubinstein (Germany, 1998) and pianist Maria Yulin (Israel, 1988) perform ‘Colloque sentimental’ from Claude Debussy’s Fêtes galantes II; ‘Die Geister am Mummelsee’ from Hugo Wolf’s Mörike-Lieder; ‘Bei dir allein’ from Franz Schubert’s Vier Refrainlieder, D. 866; Bart Visman’s Vermeer’s Gold; ‘La fleur qui va sur l'eau’ from Gabriel Fauré’s Trois melodies, Op.

programme.title: England, my England - I
programme.desc: From August 28 to September 6, 2015, the Early Music Festival Utrecht focused on England, my England. On the basis of the festival theme, presenter Lex Bohlmeijer takes the viewer in a two-part documentary on an intriguing journey through England of the Middle Ages, Renaissance and Baroque, and relates this to the city of Utrecht.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Sonata No. 5, KV 283
programme.desc: Italian pianist Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5, KV. 283. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Bruckner - Symphony No. 5
programme.desc: Bruckner's Fifth Symphony has been called the 'Medieval' because of its multi-layered, Baroque, contrapuntal tonal textures and the 'Catholic' because of its solemn majesty. These designations are uniquely fitting to the work, Bruckner himself called it his 'Fantastic,' especially when it is performed at the Monastery of St. Florian, as on this recording.

programme.title: Works for cello and piano: Debussy, Gershwin a.o.
programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform a wonderful recital as part of the 2023 edition of the Amiata Piano Festival. On the program are Claude Debussy’s Cello Sonata, L. 135; Allegro moderato from Camille Saint-Saëns’s Cello Sonata No. 1 in C minor, Op. 32; Allegro ma non troppo from Johannes Brahms’s Cello Sonata No. 1 in E minor, Op.

programme.title: Teatro Regio behind the scenes
programme.desc: Few Italian theatres can boast of being an absolute point of reference for national and world culture. The Teatro Regio in Turin is both a symbol of excellence in the national operatic tradition and a prestigious stage hosting operas, ballets, concerts, and musicals of great substance.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 1 for chamber orchestra
programme.desc: As part of the ‘Da Camera’ concert series of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid, the Spanish Grupo Fundación Mutua Madrileña performs Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 1 in D major, ‘Titan’, in an arrangement for chamber orchestra by conductor Francisco Alonso Serena. The slowly starting opening movement of the symphony depicts the awakening of nature in spring.

programme.title: The Babylon Hotel
programme.desc: One night only! Welcome to the spectacular and decadent world of The Babylon Hotel, where music pours out of every crevice like bubbling champagne. In this concert, the upper class meets the underworld in a melting pot of euphoria and extravagance, nostalgia and pleasure with a carefree sinfulness only seen in the exuberant nightlife of the 1920s around the world.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 9, Op. 125
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle leads the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) and Chorus in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125. The soloists are Iwona Sobotka (soprano), Anna Stephany (mezzo-soprano), Robert Murray (tenor), and Florian Boesch (baritone).

programme.title: Franz in Vienna: Mozart and Schoenberg
programme.desc: Austrian conductor Franz Welser-Möst leads his Cleveland Orchestra in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Divertimento No. 2 in D major, KV 131, and Arnold Schoenberg’s Variations for Orchestra, Op. 31, recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland, USA. In addition, Welser-Möst takes a walk through ‘his’ Vienna, enlightening us on this musical capital that was home to both Mozart and Schoenberg. He contrasts the Divertimento No.

programme.title: PIAM - Semi-final I: Chopin and Scriabin
programme.desc: Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano.

programme.title: Bach - Partita for Violin No. 2 (BWV 1004)
programme.desc: Celebrated German violinist Isabelle Faust performs J. S. Bach’s Partita No. 2 in D minor (BWV 1004). The work is part of the composer’s well-known Sonatas and Partitas for Solo Violin (BWV 1001-1006). Partita No. 2 is made up of four dance movements, concluded by its famous Chaconne, a monumental piece within the violin repertoire.

programme.title: Kristine Opolais Recital
programme.desc: Critics praise her, and the audience loves her. Kristine Opolais, the prima donna and the star of the New York Metropolitan Opera, performs in her home country Latvia. She gives a splendid concert with the Latvian National Symphony Orchestra, at the Latvian National Opera, in 2017. The program includes arias from operas that made Kristine an international star.

programme.title: Semi Final I - Liszt Competition 2017
programme.desc: Jenny Chen (1994, Taiwan) performs Tchaikovsky/Liszt - Polonaise aus der Oper Jewgeny Onegin, S429, Rubinstein/Liszt - Zwei Lieder, S554 und Rapsodie Espagnole, S254 during the semi-final I (transcription) of the 11th International Franz Liszt Piano Competition, held in TivoliVredenburg, Utrecht, in 2017. The competition actively presents, develops, and promotes piano talents from around the world.

programme.title: Les Bains Macabres
programme.desc: French composer Guillaume Connesson (*1970) is building an impressive musical oeuvre, to which he has recently added an opera: 'Les bains macabres'. For this romantic contemporary thriller opera he worked closely with librettist Olivier Bleys (*1970), a successful French author with dozens of novels to his credit.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 1
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Von Zemlinsky - Clarinet Trio, Op. 3
programme.desc: The Valerius Ensemble, consisting of Jorge Gaona Ros (clarinet), Ksenia Kouzmenko (piano) and René Geesing (cello) plays Von Zemlinsky’s Klarinet Trio, Op. 3. It was recorded in Concordia, Enschede, on February 18, 2018. Zemlinsky was born in Vienna of a Slovak father and Sarajevan mother and studied at the Vienna Conservatoire. In his early twenties, his chamber work was performed at the Wiener Tonkünstlerverein.

programme.title: Donizetti - Don Pasquale
programme.desc: Frédéric Chaslin leads the Orchestre Symphonique Région Centre-Val de Loire/Tours and the Choir of Opéra de Tours in a performance of Gaetano Donizetti’s comic opera Don Pasquale (1842). Featuring a cast of the most famous singers of the day, Don Pasquale premiered at the Parisian Salle Ventadour in 1843. It was an immediate success, being performed in the great opera houses of Europe within a year after its premiere.

programme.title: A Mozart Concert from Berlin
programme.desc: The Carl Philipp Emanuel Bach Chamber Orchestra delivers a program entirely devoted to Mozart at the Konzerthaus in Berlin under the direction of Hartmut Haenchen. In reduced form, the ensemble manages to bring to life the many characteristics of the music and the unique spirit of the famous composer, be it his gaiety of heart, his lyricism, his dramatic side or his polyphonic writing inspired.

programme.title: My heart is burning
programme.desc: René Pape perfectly embodies the new generation of opera singers: with a current and relaxed appearance, he craves new challenges and demonstrates an openness to ambitious experimentation. In the musical film My Heart Is Burning, René Pape sings and plays various roles that showcase the impressive versatility of his voice and the many facets of his personality. Directed by Sibylle Muth.

programme.title: Holst - The Planets
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam and the Nationaal Vrouwen Jeugdkoor in a performance of Gustav Holst’s The Planets, Op. 32, recorded at De Doelen, Rotterdam, in 2019. Van Alphen founded Sinfonia Rotterdam in 2000. Under his passionate leadership, this orchestra has developed into one of the Netherland’s best-known orchestras.

programme.title: IVC 2019 - Final: Schubert, Schumann et al.
programme.desc: Soprano Harriet Burns (United Kingdom, 1989) and pianist Ian Tindale (United Kingdom, 1990) perform Franz Schubert’s Verklärung, D. 59; Clara Schumann’s Er ist gekommen in Sturm und Regen, Op. 12, No. 2; ‘L’heure exquise’ from Reynaldo Hahn’s Chansons grises, and ‘Le printemps’ from Hahn’s Douze rondels; ‘Herzeleid’ from Robert Schumann’s Sechs Gesänge, Op.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mozart - Symphony No. 39, K. 543
programme.desc: David Zinman conducts the Deutsche Kammerphilharmonie in a performance of W. A. Mozart’s (1756-1791) Symphony No. 39, K. 543. Recorded in the Sophiensaal in Munich in 1991 and directed by János Darvas. The work is the first in a set of three which became Mozart’s last symphonies. The set was composed in rapid succession in the summer of 1788. The first movement opens with a majestic introduction with fanfares heard in the brass section.

programme.title: Rodrigo - Concierto de Aranjuez
programme.desc: Juan Manuel Cañizares is the soloist in a performance of Joaquín Rodrigo's (1901-1999) Concierto de Aranjuez. He is accompanied by the Berliner Philharmoniker led by maestro Sir Simon Rattle.

programme.title: Works by Haydn, Mozart and Saint-Saëns
programme.desc: Italian cellist and conductor Enrico Bronzi leads the Orchestra da Camera di Perugia in this intimate concert at the magnificent Basilica di San Pietro in the Italian city of Perugia, recorded on September 27, 2021. Opening the program is a cello performance by Bronzi with the Orchestra da Camera di Peruglia: the Andante cantabile from Joseph Haydn’s Symphony No. 13 in D major, Hob. I:13.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Semi-finals: Wolf, Debussy a. o.
programme.desc: IVC 2021 - Semi-finals: Wolf, Debussy a. o.

programme.title: Patmos – A musical documentary
programme.desc: Every summer, the Greek island of Patmos hosts the Patmos Musical Festival, a unique musical event comprising both a Chamber and a Sacred Music Festival. This documentary captures the 2024 edition, featuring performances by distinguished soloists and ensembles from around the world.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Concerto No. 14, KV 449
programme.desc: Regarded as one of the finest interpreters of Romantic repertoire, Francesco Attesti (*1975) gave his first recital at age 11 and by the time he was 23, had earned the highest honours in piano from Florence’s Conservatorio Luigi Cherubini. In this recording of his 2016 Deeply Mozart concert tour, Attesti performs Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s piano concertos KV 449 and KV 488 with the Italian OIDA Orchestra and conductor Paolo Belloli.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Bruckner - Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: In a 2019 performance from the Muziekgebouw in Eindhoven, Hartmut Haenchen conducts the philharmonie zuidnederland for this performance of Anton Bruckner’s Symphony No. 7.

programme.title: Rina Sala Gallo Piano Competition 2022 - Finalists
programme.desc: The Rina Sala Gallo International Piano Competition takes place every two years in the Italian city of Monza. Founded in 1947 by Monza-born pianist Rina Sala Gallo and Brescia-born pianist Arturo Benedetti Michelangeli, the competition is one of Monza’s most prestigious cultural events today.

programme.title: Memory of a Concert
programme.desc: In 2006, Gidon Kremer and Martha Argerich set out on tour performing solos and duets by Bartók und Schumann. The last of the concert series at the Berliner Philharmonie has been recorded for this film, featuring a rare solo performance by Martha Argerich. A concert film with personal and moving commentary by Gidon Kremer. Program: Schumann's Violin Sonata No. 1, Op. 10, Violin Sonata No. 2, Op. 121; Kinderszenen, Op.

programme.title: Glière, Op. 20 and Shostakovich, Op. 57
programme.desc: The Valerius Ensemble, consisting of Robert Windak (violin), Michael Rein (violin), Eva Šušlíková (viola), Judith Chapman (cello) and Ingo Lylofs (piano) played a concert in Muziekcentrum Enschede on April 15, 2018. On the concert program are the Allegro Moderato from Glières String Quartet No. 2 and the Scherzo, Intermezzo, and Finale from Shostakovich’s Piano Quintet, Op. 57.

programme.title: Debussy - La Mer
programme.desc: Claude Debussy’s symphonic sketches for orchestra known collectively as ‘La Mer’ evoke a richly varied vision of the sea. The first part (‘De l’aube á midi sur la mer’) calls up a morning and afternoon at sea, the second (‘Jeux de vagues’) echoes the play of the waves, and the third and final part (‘Dialogue du vent et de la mer’) conjures the communing voices of wind and waves.

programme.title: Gershwin - Greatest Hits
programme.desc: Belgian conductor Jos van Immerseel leads Anima Eterna Brugge in a concert program dedicated to American composer George Gershwin. The program opens with Gershwin’s symphonic suite Catfish Row (arr. Steven D. Bowen) which is based upon music from his famous opera Porgy and Bess (1935). This is followed by the well-known tone poem An American in Paris (1928).

programme.title: Ravel - Boléro
programme.desc: French conductor Adrien Perruchon leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Maurice Ravel’s famous Boléro. The Boléro, one of the world’s most popular classical pieces, was commissioned by Russian dancer Ida Rubinstein. She asked the composer to create ballet music of a Spanish character. Ravel’s 1928 composition is inspired by the bolero, a Spanish dance in 3/4 time that originated from the 18th century.

programme.title: Delibes – Coppélia
programme.desc: A classic French ballet, Coppélia was choreographed in 1870 at the Opera de Paris, drawing inspiration from the evolution of society and the choreographer’s imagination. Featuring 40 dancers, the action takes place in the America of Fred Astaire, Gene Kelly, and Jérôme Robbins and echoes the style and spirit of Broadway musicals and Hollywood fantasies.

programme.title: Roberto Giordano plays Brahms and Beethoven
programme.desc: In this recital, Roberto Giordano plays the Six Pieces for Piano, op. 118 of Brahms, a collection completed in 1893 and dedicated to Clara Schumann who will be the penultimate produced by the composer during his lifetime. The concert program also includes two Beethoven sonatas, the famous Moonlight Sonata No. 14, op. 27, and Sonata No. 31, op. 110, one of the last sonatas signed by the composer.

programme.title: Rachmaninoff - Piano Concerto No. 4 And Nielsen 6th
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in this powerful performance taken from the 150th Anniversary celebrations of Denmark’s national composer, Carl Nielsen. Alongside Nielsen’s inscrutably ironic Symphony No. 6, this performance features world-renowned French pianist Lise de la Salle as soloist in Rachmaninov’s Piano Concerto No. 4.

programme.title: PIAM - Semi-final I: Chopin and Mozart
programme.desc: Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano.

programme.title: Brahms - Tragic Overture in D minor Op. 81
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy’s oldest opera and arts festival. It was founded in 1933 with the aim of presenting contemporary and forgotten operas. Over the years, the scope widened, and orchestral concerts have long been an integral part of the festival.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Fauré’s Requiem
programme.desc: 2024 marks the 100th anniversary of Gabriel Fauré's death. He is considered one of the most important and influential composers, having been the teacher of Maurice Ravel, Georges Enescu, Nadia Boulanger and many others.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - The Nutcracker
programme.desc: Tchaikovsky's The Nutcracker is one of the best known and most beloved pieces from the composer. The music has inspired many choreographers to the tell the colourful Christmas fairy-tale of E. T. A. Hoffmann and Alexandre Dumas senior in the language of dance. Ben Stevenson is to this day considered one of the most important influencers of the American ballet art.

programme.title: Delibes - Lakmé
programme.desc: Frédéric Chaslin (1963) leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the Opéra Royal de Wallonie-Liège in a performance of Léo Delibes’s tragic opera Lakmé (1883). Written to a libretto by Edmond Gondinet and Philippe Gille, the opera is set in nineteenth-century British India and tells the story of Lakmé, who falls in love with Gérald, a British officer.

programme.title: Waldbühne 1993: Russian Night
programme.desc: Every year the Berliner Philharmoniker gives an outstanding concert at the Waldbühne. This amphitheatre in Berlin can host 22,000 people and is used for many events such as film showings, boxing matches and concerts. In 1993 the Berliner Philharmoniker, under the baton of the Japanese conductor Seiji Ozawa, performed a Russian program. The concert starts with Russian Easter Festival Overture, Op.

programme.title: The Boy with the Wig: Kids on Mozart
programme.desc: The Boy with the Wig - Kids on Mozart explores children’s fascination with the composer. The 30-minute film by Claus Wischmann features boys and girls aged between eight and eleven recounting his life through humour and serious interpretations of Mozart’s biography. Discover Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart through the eyes of children.

programme.title: Mistérios Da Natureza T1 - Ep. 6

programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 46
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Anita Oday Live in Sweden 1963
programme.desc: Anita O’Day?boasts two wonderful concerts from 1963 and 1970 that present the “jazz singer supreme” in impeccable form. O’Day’s horn-based approach to singing is in full effect throughout both shows including stand-out renditions in each show of audience favorites “Tea For Two” and “Sweet Georgia Brown” (both reprised from her triumphant appearance at the 1958 Newport Jazz Festival.

programme.title: TorTube: Tingvall Trio - Vägen
programme.desc: Jazz fans in television land have come to the right place for their dose of first-rate world jazz: TorTube! Jazz club De Tor in Enschede is one of Europe’s most authentic jazz venues, with an absolutely unique ambiance. Some of the best musicians from Holland and the rest of the world find their way to De Tor to perform for an appreciative audience of jazz fans.

programme.title: Bantu Jazz: Frédéric Gassita And Friends
programme.desc: Pianist Frédéric Gassita studied classical music and jazz, the latter at the famed Berklee College of Music in Boston. Apart from French impressionists, such as Ravel and Debussy, Gassita’s main influences are Chick Corea and Herbie Hancock, both of whom he met during his studies in Berklee. His body of musical work, however, is rooted in Africa, where the he currently resides. Today he’s a figurehead of jazz in Gabon, Africa.

programme.title: Forró Series
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed and curated in São Paulo by director and presenter Dani Gurgel and producer and engineer Thiago Rabello, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor.

The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: I Didn't Know What Time It Was
programme.desc: The legendary hard-bop group Art Blakey's Jazz Messengers performed in Olympia Hall in Paris, France on March 16, 1963. Led by drummer Art Blakey, the Jazz Messengers consisted of Wayne Shorter on tenor saxophone, Freddie Hubbard on trumpet, Curtis Fuller on trombone, Reggie Workman on double bass, and Cedar Walton on piano. Each of these players became jazz legends in their own right.

programme.title: Stingray PausePlay: RY X
programme.desc: We Pause and chat with local and international artists to get an in-depth look at their lives and music, they Play some amazing music in these, one-of-a-kind, live sessions! These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life.

programme.title: Count Basie and his Orchestra live in Charleroi
programme.desc: Count Basie is one of the most important bandleaders of the swing era. With the exception of a brief period in the early '50s, he led a big band from 1935 until his death almost 50 years later. Basie's orchestra was characterized by a light, swinging rhythm section that he led from the piano, lively ensemble work, and generous soloing. Basie was not a composer like Duke Ellington or an important soloist like Benny Goodman.

programme.title: Fay Claassen: Two Portraits of Chet Baker
programme.desc: In 2013 it is 25 years ago that singer and trumpet player Chet Baker mysteriously died, caused by a fall from the window of his hotel room in Amsterdam. His music is more popular than ever. This concert is performed by Fay Claassen, who became internationally known through her album ‘Two Portraits of Chet Baker’. In the U.S. this album was the ‘Best Vocal Album of the Year’.

programme.title: BIRD - The Nest
programme.desc: Five promising musicians get together in Rotterdam jazz club BIRD’s artists-in-residence project “The Nest”. Over the course of seven sessions, these talents exchange ideas, work on their projects, and play music together. Following this period, during which record producer Jameszoo and music manager Jochem Tromp offer their coaching experience, BIRD and North Sea Jazz Festival’s fringe festival DownTown organize a tryout performance.

programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Non Stop Travels: The Story of Michel Petrucciani
programme.desc: This film portrays Michel Petrucciani 's very unique outlook on life, his vitality, boisterous humor and marked comedian talent which triumphes over all physical restrictions. It also shows Michel Petrucciani performing, composing, selecting his very own piano, at a recording session with Stephane Grapelli, Roy Haynes and Georges Mraz, .... and much more.

programme.title: Toko Telo - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: Curtis Stigers - Fly Me To The Moon
programme.desc: The Danish Radio Big Band joins forces with American vocalist Curtis Stigers to celebrate Frank Sinatra's iconic concerts at The Sands Hotel in Las Vegas. Curtis Stigers and the big band present the most popular evergreens from the American songbook of the 1950s and 1960s, one of which is the classic that lend the concert its name: “Fly Me To The Moon”.

programme.title: Donna lee
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world.

programme.title: Adjustment
programme.desc: Legendary jazz pianist Horace Silver's groundbreaking fusion of hard bop, blues, soulful grooves and Cape Verdean influences have left an indelible mark on the world of jazz. At the renowned Umbria Jazz Festival in the picturesque region of Umbria, Italy, Silver is accompanied by a great band of future all-stars: Bob Berg on tenor sax, Tom Harrell on trumpet, Steve Beskrone on bass and Eddie Gladden on drums.

programme.title: Dave Brubeck and Paul Desmond live in Belgium
programme.desc: Dave Brubeck: Live in '64 boasts a beautifully filmed concert from one of the most beloved quartets in jazz history.

programme.title: Michiel Borstlap: Blue, Reflective And Frames
programme.desc: Recorded at the Amsterdam Arena during the Amsterdam South East Jazz Festival, Michiel Borstlap tickles the ivories of his Steinway in performances of all his favourite songs on his solo albums ‘Blue’, ‘Reflective’, and ‘Frames’. An unprecedented event: a solo piano concert at the home base of football club Ajax Amsterdam!

programme.title: John Scofield - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Episode 1: Thelonious Monk - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: The idiosyncratic pianist and composer Thelonious Monk (1917-1982) is one of the all-time greats of jazz. His music went largely misunderstood for the first 15 years of his career, after which he was rightly hailed as a genius, and received credit as a founding father of bebop.

programme.title: A$AP Rocky And A$AP Ferg - At The Hordern Pavilion
programme.desc: Big hits, booty dancing, stage dives, fan freestyles and of course, controversy, A$AP Rocky's debut Down Under tour had it all! At his sold-out Sydney show, hip hop's hottest star and 5000 rowdy fans got wild for the night at the Hordern Pavilion and we captured it all exclusively.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Paradox Live: Philippe Lemm Trio
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.title: Burton Greene - OTO Part II
programme.desc: Legendary free jazz pianist Burton Greene rose to fame in New York City's free jazz scene of the 1960s. Exploring various spontaneous improvisational styles, Greene performs live at Cafe OTO in London, UK.

programme.title: Keiko's Birthday March
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

programme.title: Larry Graham: Ultimate Funk at the Bataclan
programme.desc: This recording brings a great performance by Larry Graham And Graham Central Station from Bataclan in Paris. Numerous ‘funkateers’ came together to cheer the bass player and funk hero. In the sixties, Graham was mainly known for his work with Sly and the Family Stone, the popular and influential psychedelic soul and funk band. As founder and front man of Graham Central Station he has also enjoyed a successful solo career.

programme.title: Christian Scott - The Centennial Trilogy
programme.desc: In just a few years, young trumpet player Christian Scott has become synonymous with a new jazz generation. He shakes up the conventions of jazz by taking the genre to new horizons and reaching a wider audience. No doubt, at 33 years old, Christian Scott is already forging his own path. After each record release, he seems even more determined to challenge the rules of jazz with his own avant-garde style.

programme.title: Wynton in the South Bank Show
programme.desc: Considered one of the most technically brilliant players in the history of the trumpet, jazz musician Wynton Marsalis is also a master of classical music and a fine composer. Marsalis takes the cameras with him around New York, to his home town of New Orleans, and to his rehearsal studios where he and his assembled band of musicians are seen putting together the album Blood on the Fields.

programme.title: Belgium Sessions: Free Desmyter
programme.desc: In this DJAZZ Belgium Sessions performance, which was recorded at AED Studios in Lint, Belgium, we witness Europe’s finest jazz musicians at work. A wide variety of international jazz musicians give a creative, up-close and inside insight into their art of playing jazz music. Young talent and established jazz musicians play to their heart’s content: take for instance this unusual performance by the Free Desmyter Quartet.

programme.title: Eartha Kitt: The Most Exciting Woman in the World
programme.desc: They called her “the most exciting woman in the world”, and this Afro-American voice lived up to this expectation with international flair. Eartha Kitt was one of the reigning queens of blues and jazz. She epitomized the idea of the sex-kitten chanteuse, rising to fame with a nightclub act centered on her slinky stage presence and throaty purr.

programme.title: Mike Stern And Didier Lockwood: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Guitarist Mike Stern and violin player Didier Lockwood sharing a stage: that promises a good show! After playing for years with Blood, Sweat And Tears, Mike Stern landed a gig with drummer Billy Cobham and then broke through with Miles Davis’ comeback band in the 1980s. Didier Lockwood played in jazz fusion band Magma during the 1970s and is known for his use of electric amplification and experimentation.

programme.title: Great Male Vocalists - collage
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential male jazz and pop vocalists in history showcases these legends’ unique essence. Delight in the expressive beauty and emotional depth of Chet Baker's rendition of “Time After Time” and “You Don't Know What Love Is', recorded live in Brussels, Belgium in 1964 and in Rome, Italy in 1956 respectively.

programme.title: Terrasson And Belmondo: À Nous Garo
programme.desc: Every year, the Jazz en Baie festival takes place in the beautiful bay of Mont Saint-Michel Today’s broadcast shows a special gathering between two grandmasters of French jazz: pianist Jacky Terrasson and trumpeter Stéphane Belmondo. The two team up for an amazing concert in which jazz is combined with soul and a touch of chanson française.

programme.title: Lex Jasper Trio: Happy Days Are Here Again
programme.desc: Lex Jasper Trio: Happy Days Are Here Again - the title says is all… After an automobile accident and 15 years of revalidation, he is back! Together with his musical pals Edwin Corzilius (double bass) and Frits Landesbergen (drums), pianist and composer Lex Jasper celebrates his return to jazz club The Duke in the Dutch village of Nistelrode.

programme.title: Milt Jacksons' Modern Jazz Quartet at the Bozar
programme.desc: The Modern Jazz Quartet (MJQ) was composed of Milt 'Bags' Jackson on vibraphone, John Lewis on piano, Percy Heath on bass, and Connie Kay on drums. Milt Jackson and John Lewis were pioneer bebop musicians who had played together in Dizzy Gillespie's 1948 big band. They pursued separate careers before adding Heath and Lewis to form the Modern Jazz Quartet in the 1950s.

programme.title: Where Are We Now - Part I
programme.desc: German jazz and cabaret singer Atrin Madani was born in 1998 as the son of Iranian immigrants. In the face of pandemic uncertainty, geopolitical upheaval, and social unrest in his ancestral home country, Madani asked himself: where are we now? His response to this question is as clear and precise as his singing: what we need most right now is honesty, humility, and quality.

programme.title: Jazz de Matosinhos and Sinfónica do Porto: Layas
programme.desc: 30 minutes of... Orquestra Jazz de Matosinhos and Orquestra Sinfónica do Porto Casa da Música conducted by Dirk Brossé. Casa da Música is a performance hall located in Porto, in northern Portugal. Brossé, born in Ghent, Belgium in 1960, is a versatile composer and a respected conductor on the international music scene. Pianist Jason Moran and cellist J.A. Pereira de Sousa accompany both sets.

programme.desc: The Dutch Hammond organ player Rob Mostert develops, in cooperation with DJAZZ, the programme ‘Mostert Meets’. In this series, the Hammond B3 organ takes centre stage. Rob Mostert invites the world’s finest jazz musicians for a musical collaboration, in which the Hammond Organ plays a major role.

programme.title: Blue Note 75th Anniversary: Blue Note All Stars
programme.desc: Blue Note Records is arguably the most prestigious jazz label. Since its foundation in 1939, it has continued to attract young talent. To celebrate the label's 75th anniversary in 2014, young musicians formed the 2014 Blue Note All Stars and appeared at the Blue Note Jazz Festival at the Gaîté Lyrique in Paris.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Hypnotic Brass Ensemble
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s BIRD is a club, café, and restaurant with a live music program that's deeply rooted in jazz, soul, funk, hip-hop, and electronic. Its name BIRD refers to the nickname of legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker. BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, fine wines, no-nonsense beers, and an all-round metropolitan rawness. Since 2014, this urban jazz club and DJAZZ.

programme.title: Morgenland Festival: One Way Ticket to Damascus
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival of Osnabrueck has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects.

programme.title: Tristan And The Heavy Horns
programme.desc: Tristan is synonymous with funky guitars, Fender Rhodes pianos, synthesizers, and a well-travelled rhythm section. The instant they hit the stage, the warm energies, vibes and grooves of the 1970s come alive, albeit infused with modern influences. The band’s vintage, feel-good acid jazz brings out the best in vocalist Evelyn Kallansee.

programme.title: The Skymasters with Clark Terry - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1989, Dutch big band and radio orchestra The Skymasters took flight at the North Sea Jazz Festival in the Hague.

programme.desc: Despite his advanced age, the legendary jazz pianist Earl Hines was at the top of his game when he performed in the Belgian town of Spa in 1977. With a band consisting of Rudy Rutherford (reeds), Jimmy Leary (bass), and Eddie Graham (drums), Hines livens up the room with his interpretations of “I Can’t Believe That You’re In Love With Me” and “The Man I Love.

programme.title: Patáx: A Night to Remember 1/2
programme.desc: Patáx was heavily influenced by seminal fusion bands like Weather Report and Return to Forever. Don’t mistake this Spanish powerhouse for a carbon copy of either, however, as Patáx presents an accomplished mix of styles, including soul, jazz, funk and hip-hop. The group is led by the passionate Spanish-American percussionist Jorge Perez, who draws his musical influence from both sides of the Atlantic.

programme.title: Salif Keita And Les Ambassadeurs
programme.desc: Salif Keita’s music is a rich combination of traditional Malian music with European and American influences. We can hear this in the instrumentation of Keita’s music, which varies from traditional West-African instruments to Western European ones. The Malian singer was cast out by his family because of his albinism. In 1967 he moved to Bamako, where he started his musical career and joined Les Ambassadeurs (Internationaux).

programme.title: Nasheet Waits - K-Kelli Sketch
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn’ at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, RAndB, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical.

programme.title: Sunrise
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The Crusaders, an American jazz fusion group that was popular in the '70s employed a two-manned front-line horn section.

programme.title: Hayo Hayta
programme.desc: Double bassist Avishai Cohen’s trio with Noam David (drums) and Omri Mor (pianist) joined forces with the international Symphony Orchestra ‘INSO-Lviv’, conducted by Christian Schumann. On June 24, 2017 they brought Avishai Cohen’s signature blend of influences from Eastern Europe, American jazz and the Middle East to the Alfa Jazz Festival in Lviv, Ukraine.

programme.title: Public Enemy - Live at The Metro Theatre
programme.desc: Public Enemy, also known as PE, is an influential hip hop group from Long Island, New York, known for its politically charged lyrics, criticism of the media, and active interest in the concerns of the African American community. In 2004, Rolling Stone Magazine ranked Public Enemy number forty-four on its list of the Immortals: 100. Here, the group performs at The Metro Theatre, in Sydney, Australia, on December 27, 2008.

programme.title: Sammy Price and the Harlem Beggars
programme.desc: Pianist, singer and civil rights activist Sammy Price is joined by the gospel singers known as the Harlem Beggars for spirited renditions of “Go Tell It on the Mountain,” “I’m a Soldier,” and “When the Saints Go Marching In,” among several others. The group is joined by Wilbert Harrison, who provides accompaniment on organ.

programme.title: Don Cherry's 'Multikulti'
programme.desc: Trumpeter Don Cherry was a musician of great versatility, creating an endless variety of styles and influencing generations of musicians. Multikulti presents a never-before heard mixture of international sounds, from mainstream jazz to reggae, in his first collaboration with the amazing Peter Apfelbaum, one of the most in-demand performers at jazz festivals all over the world.

programme.title: Os Maias - Ep. 20
programme.desc: Carlos se encanta por Maria Eduarda. Joaquim acusa a esposa de estar apaixonada por outro. Joaquim presenteia Carlos. Teresinha casa com Vilaça. Carlos envia convite a Joaquim.

programme.title: Saia Justa - Ep. 5
programme.desc: O Saia Justa chega à 25ª temporada, com Eliana no comando do sofá e Bela Gil, Tati Machado, Érika Januza e Juliette debatendo os temas mais relevantes com leveza e acolhimento.

programme.title: Alma Gêmea - Ep. 22
programme.desc: Serena nega o dinheiro de Cristina. Filó desconfia de Dalila. Mirna fica furiosa com uma descoberta. Raul dá flores a Olívia. Guto oferece ajuda a Kátia em troca de um escândalo.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 124
programme.desc: Leonardo e Angélico discutem, e Viviane recebe apoio de Zenilda. Lígia reage ao saber por Kellen da prisão de Viviane. Joaquim sugere que Júnior passe um tempo na casa de Maggye para poder vigiar Kasper. Ao ver a bala de revólver que atingiu Bagdá, Kasper intriga o bandido quando afirma que o tiro que levou parece ter saído da arma de um civil. Vandílson avisa a Lucélia que Kasper está com Bagdá.

programme.title: Império - Ep. 70
programme.desc: Maria Marta ameaça Téo Pereira. José Alfredo e Cristina desconfiam de Cora. A notícia sobre o falso exame de DNA do Comendador e Cristina cai na boca do povo.

Susana descobre que Camilo pretende apresentar Jane a Julieta. Darcy confessa a Elisabeta que mentiu.

programme.title: Cobras And Lagartos - Ep. 178
programme.desc: Foguinho é humilhado. Bel conversa com Silvana sobre Pereira/Omar. Letícia é presa. Marilene encontra Téo. Duda vai até a Luxus interditar Leona e ela comete uma grande loucura.

programme.title: Coração Acelerado - Ep. 100
programme.desc: Agrado afirma a João Raul que prefere não divulgar sua composição com ele. Zilá volta ao normal e se incomoda ao lembrar de seu comportamento estranho. Valéria pede uma nova chance para conviver com Eduarda. Naiane questiona por que João Raul procurou Agrado. Zuzu descobre que foi Zilá quem inventou que Janete roubou o anel de Branca no passado. Janete procura Zilá.

programme.title: Explode Coração - Ep. 148
programme.desc: Edu se disfarça de cigano para fugir da polícia. Eugênia se oferece para ajudar Júlio a encontrar Dara. Odaísa tenta ajudar Dara a fugir. Júlio encontra Vera ao visitar os pais.

programme.desc: Paula decide ajudar Maria do Carmo. Caio desconfia dos planos de Renato. Laurinha recebe visita inesperada. Edu surpreende Laurinha ao fazer pedido inesperado ao acordar.

programme.desc: Vera ameaça expor os pais de Júlio na mídia. Salgadinho e Lucineide descobrem que Edu não foi preso. Dara confessa medo para Soraya. Ianca atrapalha os planos de Igor.

programme.title: Alma Gêmea - Ep. 23
programme.desc: Cristina surpreende Rafael. Generosa provoca Dalila. Hélio fica arrasado com uma confissão de Serena. Mirna se anima com uma visita. Cristina arma contra Olívia. Kátia beija Raul.

programme.title: Orgulho E Paixão - Ep. 13
programme.desc: Susana planeja convidar Ofélia para o jantar de Camilo, Jane e Julieta. Todos comentam sobre o motoqueiro misterioso e Mariana desconfia. Mariana se incomoda com a situação entre Uirapuru e Lídia. Elisabeta discute com Ema. Os soldados comentam com Brandão sobre o motoqueiro, e o coronel se sente constrangido. Julieta aceita conhecer Jane, e Camilo se surpreende com a suposta ajuda de Susana.

programme.title: Coração Acelerado - Ep. 101
programme.desc: Janete pressiona Zilá, que acaba confessando à irmã que foi ela quem roubou o anel e procurou Jean Carlos. Janete grava a confissão de Zilá e envia para Alaorzinho. Zilá se desespera ao ver que Alaorzinho ouviu a mensagem de Janete, e tenta despistar o marido. Alaorzinho garante que não quer mais saber de Zilá. Naiane se recusa a mostrar a João Raul uma foto de sua infância.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 125
programme.desc: Arminda marca encontro com Joaquim no ferro-velho. Zenilda sente orgulho de Leonardo quando o filho se dispõe a ajudar o grupo de Rogério a acabar com Ferette. Arminda coloca Ferette para dormir com um sonífero dado por Helga. Júnior aceita passar alguns dias na casa de Maggye. Kasper fica assustado quando é convocado por Juquinha a depor sobre o roubo das Três Graças.

programme.title: Império - Ep. 71
programme.desc: José Alfredo fica enfurecido com Cora. Cristina se revolta com a armação e sofre com toda a confusão armada. João Lucas se entrega à paixão. Maria Marta sai com Maurílo.

programme.desc: Clara tenta convencer Totó que Gemma está doente. Adamo e Francesca têm noite de amor. Lorena conta a Saulo e Stela que Agnello é sobrinho de Totó.

programme.title: Contos Das Estrelinhas

programme.title: Chocolix

programme.title: Gemini 8
programme.desc: Gemini 8 é uma série animada que narra as aventuras de Marco, um garoto terrestre que, ao ser puxado por uma pipa através de um portal, é transportado para o distante planeta Gemini 8. Apresenta uma mistura de aventura e ficção científica, explorando temas como amizade, exploração e o desconhecido.

programme.title: Palavras Que Rimam
programme.desc: A cada episódio, explore de maneira divertida e ritmada como pronunciar corretamente palavras que rimam, com muita diversão e aprendizagem. Vai ajudar a pronunciar melhor as palavras. De maneira divertida vai estimular a associação das palavras e desta forma facilitar o teu processo de alfabetização.

programme.desc: Explora a riqueza cultural de Angola com o programa 'Como se Diz' na Kanuca TV! Este Programa e educativo é a chave para desvendar a diversidade linguística do nosso País.

programme.title: Mongo E Drongo
programme.desc: Mongo e Drongo são os nossos protagonistas, dois orfãos inseparáveis que se conheceram ainda bebês e continuam suas aventuras repletas de humor, amizade e descobertas. Mongo é o menino vaidoso e mandão enquanto que Drongo é esforçado e sempre de alto astral. Ambos enfrentam novos desafios enquanto estreitam ainda mais seus laços e conhecem novos amigos.

programme.title: Isto É O Povo A Falar T9 - Ep. 168
programme.desc: ISTO É O POVO A FALAR' é um programa de entrevista e reportagem que aborda assuntos controversos e atuais vividos na sociedade portuguesa. Trata-se de um programa feito a pensar no Povo Português, em prol da sua dignidade e da proteção dos seus direitos enquanto cidadãos.

programme.title: ABC Da Família - Ep. 62
programme.desc: Programa destinado a todas as pessoas que desejem conhecer a vontade de Deus para a sua vida e família, incluindo temas diversificados que permitem a construção da familia baseada na palavra de Deus e também temas dedicados especialmente às mulheres.

programme.title: ABC Da Família - Ep. 63
programme.desc: Programa destinado a todas as pessoas que desejem conhecer a vontade de Deus para a sua vida e família, incluindo temas diversificados que permitem a construção da familia baseada na palavra de Deus e também temas dedicados especialmente às mulheres.

programme.title: A Rota T9 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: Programa de índole cultural onde se viaja pelo mundo à descoberta da história, cultura e gastronomia dos locais.Com reportagens produzidas localmente em diferentes países e eventos, as nossas viagens são feitas por uma equipa, que se deslocam de avião, barco ou carro à procura de novos territórios para explorar e novas aventuras para experienciar.

programme.title: Vidas Transformadas T4 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Vidas Transformadas é um programa baseado em testemunhos reais do que Deus está a fazer na vida das pessoas.

programme.title: Política And Religião - Ep. 16
programme.desc: O programa terá a presença do Apóstolo Jorge Tadeu, onde serão abordados vários temas da atualidade sobre a POLÍTICA vs o que a BÍBLIA fala.

programme.title: Maná World T2 - Ep. 68
programme.desc: Maná World é um programa que pretende dar a conhecer quem é a Igreja Maná, quem somos, o que fazemos e onde estamos, apresenta a biografia do Apóstolo Jorge Tadeu, mostrando vários departamentos do Ministério Maná.

programme.title: Aprenda A Gerir O Seu Dinheiro - Ep. 54
programme.desc: APRENDA A GERIR O SEU DINHEIRO, ensina sobre leis para poder vencer na área financeira, um programa que consiste em passar lições do Apóstolo Jorge Tadeu sobre Área Financeira.

programme.title: Espaço Mulher - Ep. 33
programme.desc: Programa destinado a todas as mulheres que desejam conhecer a vontade de Deus para a sua vida e família, temas diversificados que a vão prender ao ecra.

programme.title: 60 Minutos Com Deus T3 - Ep. 742
programme.desc: É um programa direcionado às famílias, onde abrangemos temas como, saúde, casamento, área financeira, com o intuito de ajudar a vencer, educando na fé cristã.

programme.title: Informação Ao Minuto T3 - Ep. 23
programme.desc: É o espaço noticioso diário que leva até si, de forma clara e imediata, os acontecimentos que marcam a atualidade nacional e internacional. Com uma abordagem rigorosa e acessível, o programa cedido pela TV Maná 1 à Kuriakos TV, destaca os temas mais relevantes do momento — da política à economia, da sociedade à cultura — garantindo uma informação atualizada e de confiança.

programme.title: Política And Religião - Ep. 16
programme.desc: O programa terá a presença do Apóstolo Jorge Tadeu, onde serão abordados vários temas da atualidade sobre a POLÍTICA vs o que a BÍBLIA fala.

programme.title: Na Rota Dos Angolanos T2 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Programa de índole cultural onde se viaja à descoberta dos angolanos espalhados por todo o mundo, com reportagens produzidas não só em Angola mas também um pouco por todo o mundo onde se encontrem angolanos.Com uma componente humana e social sempre presente, faz parte integrante dos nossos objectivos traçados, a interacção com os angolanos, tornando assim o programa em muito mais do que uma colectânea de imagens.

programme.title: Vila Ideal - Ep. 88
programme.desc: O programa Infantil VILA IDEAL ensina de uma forma divertida princípios básicos morais e cívicos às crianças, promovendo a amizade, a obediência, a partilha, o amor ao próximo. Os conteúdos de cada programa são temáticos, com a interação dos vários personagens.

programme.title: Superbook T5 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: Superbook ou Superlivro, é uma série anime produzida pela CBN nos Estados Unidos que narra os acontecimentos do Antigo e Novo Testamento da Biblia. Christopher 'Chris' Peeper, Joy e Gizmo (um robô) viajam juntos através do tempo e do espaço para conhecer as personagens do Livro Sagrado. Uma série sem vilões e cheia de histórias clássicas que todos conhecemos. Inédita nesta nova versão 3D em Português de Portugal.

programme.title: Das Reich - O Exército Elite De Hitler T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: 6 de Junho de 1944. Dia D. À medida que os aliados invadem as praias da Normandia, Hitler ordena a retirada de Das Reich, a famosa divisão Panzer de elite, conhecida pelas matanças na Ucrânia e na Bielorrússia, estacionada nessa altura no sudoeste de França. A sua missão: empurrar os aliados de volta para o Atlântico e virar a maré do conflicto novamente a favor dos alemães.

programme.title: Das Reich - O Exército Elite De Hitler T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: À medida que a Das Reich avança pela Normandia em Junho de 1944, a divisão protagoniza uma série de ataques brutais em aldeias francesas. Este não é um novo padrão de comportamentos, pois a Das Reich já tinha feito ataques semelhantes na Europa de leste. Agora e à medida que avançam pela França, eles massacram cruelmente aldeias inteiras de civis inocentes.

programme.title: Mega Fábricas T5 - Ep. 6
